evidence.title: Rule-Compliant Visual Spatial Planning for Multimodal Large Language Models
Multi-Agent Orchestration with the Common-Sense Reasoning Capabilities of LLMs for Autonomous Driving

summary: Researchers introduced a multimodal large language model that integrates visual spatial planning with rule‑compliant reasoning, allowing it to generate safe navigation strategies. The system also supports multi‑agent orchestration, leveraging common‑sense reasoning to improve decision‑making in autonomous driving scenarios.
title: New Multimodal LLM Framework Enables Rule-Compliant Visual Planning and Common-Sense Multi-Agent Coordination for Autonomous Driving
